featured_reviews.name: shivam saha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jairaj Thacker & Sujay Jairaj from the management of the Narsee Monjee Educational Trust inaugurate the newly furbished Jamnabai Narsee Playground on Tuesday, 11th December, 2018.

The advanced sports playground encompasses a full-size soccer pitch (FIFA approved turf), multiple cricket pitches, athletic tracks, professional stadium lights, facilities for changing, washing and storing and a specialised full pitch skeleton drain system for all weather play.

The All Stars Football Club led by Abhishek Bachchan, Ishaan Khattar, Dino Morea, Jim Sarbh, Shabir Ahluwalia, Sachin Joshi, and other celebrities played an exhibition match with the school football team to mark the opening of the playground. This is undoubtedly an exciting event bringing celebrities and sports enthusiasts together.

Amruta Fadnavis, Jaaved Jaffrey, Swaroop Rawal, Arhaan Khan, Harsha Hinduja, Schauna Chauhan also enjoyed watching the game that drew between The All Stars Football Club and students of Jamnabai Narsee School.

The All Stars Football Club is an initiative by GS Sports and Bunty Walia wherein a team of celebrities from all walks of life play football to generate money for noble causes while promoting the sport of the football.

Trustee Sujay Jairaj emphasizes that Sports has always been an integral part of Education at their schools and adds, “This full FIFA size football pitch along with a professional running track and stadium lights with multi-sport capabilities will be a boon for sports development. We will have sporting academies which will help the students to perform better at national and international levels.”

Sporting activities are an integral part of the education offered at Jamnabai Narsee School and no stone is left unturned in providing the infrastructure and opportunity. This playground will not only benefit the school population but also the community at large, bringing people together with a common goal towards fitness and well being.

Managing Trustee Mr. Jairaj Thacker said, “The Narsee Monjee Educational Trust has been a pioneer in providing state of the art sports infrastructure in order to offer a platform to students to perform and excel. This facility with international standards reiterates our commitment towards holistic education and the community at large.”

All Stars Football Club co-founder and captain, Abhishek Bachchan quoted, “Education is beyond just bookish knowledge. Sports teach us important values like teamwork, continuous determination and hard work which is needed in all our lives. All this should be inculcated in kids during a ripe age for them to lead a successful life. Facilities like these will create a

featured_reviews.name: siddhi ambukar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I studied in this school a few years ago. Honestly, my experience wasn’t great. Some teachers were extremely rude and didn’t treat students with basic respect. Instead of encouraging us, they would insult students for small mistakes, which affected confidence and mental peace.
School should be a place where children feel safe, respected, and supported  unfortunately, I didn't experience that here. Instead, I often felt demotivated and scared to ask doubts in class. While the school charged high fees which was totally not worth it.

The teachers were consistently rude towards the student , honestly there are far better school than this one.

I hope the school has improved now , but based on my experience I would not recommend it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic secondary school in the 2000s

Once at EOD notice was announced no packaged bottles to be reused as water bottle,

Bcoz some mischievous students play with it,

Toh unlokko batao naa , paise kya jhaad pe lage hai,

Also all they wanted was bottles purchased from shop, be it plastic , so means school ppl are nowhere concerned about bad effects of plastic on health,

So whatever the notice was just announced, that day itself  I already had a reused plastic bottle, thought after going home I will buy new one,

That day itself while leaving in queue , 1 of the so called monitors just snatched my bottle out from my bag, & teacher there managing the queue just praised him as if he did a big deed,

I said politely this rule just came today, then that teacher said in a very disgusting manner to me Haa chal chal ,

Is this how disgustingly your teachers behave with teenage girl students?

Some other spiritual talking teacher , when I scored top in Marathi after a lot hardworking, asked me Tula evdhe mark aaadhi kadhi milale aahet?

Some other civics teacher distributing Most introvert certificate to me , for not absurdly unlimited talking like others, & when even talked or moved a single bit then she would slap by hitting hard to wall,

Civics teacher herself having no civic sense
